_note: Event types the operator chose to DESCRIBE rather than TEST. Each one's forward returns were computed WITHOUT a pre-registered read, so no K was spent -- and, for the same reason, none of these event types (as defined below, or any narrowing of them) may ever be the subject of a pre-registered specification. Whoever has seen the outcomes cannot then claim to be predicting them. This file was committed BEFORE any outcome for these types was computed; the git history of this file against data/events/described/ shows the order.

kept_out.8k_item_2.02: already described by pead_8k_car_v3 (read 2026-11-10, NOT MET) for announcements with a two-session abnormal return >= +5%; the unconditional earnings 8-K stays undescribed so a different earnings specification remains possible

common.universe: data/universe/v27_universe.csv (907 names, frozen) -- the same universe as every frozen ledger; today's listed names only, so survivorship biases every figure UPWARD
common.entry: the first close AFTER the filing became public: the filing day's close when accepted before 16:00 ET on a session, otherwise the next session's close (8-K). Form 4: the session after the filing date, because the insider source carries no time of day.
common.independence: event_study._dedupe_overlaps, unchanged: the first event per ticker wins and any later one inside its horizon is dropped
common.delisting: recorded at last traded price, exit_status=delisted, never dropped
common.engine: event_study.run_study, imported, with no QT_SPEC_ID -- the Referee is not consulted because nothing is being tested
common.min_n: ACTUARY's MIN_N (30): below it a type reports 'insufficient history' with no statistics

8k_item_1.01.definition: an original 8-K (not 8-K/A) whose EDGAR `items` field lists 1.01 -- entry into a material definitive agreement. One event per ticker per filing date.

8k_item_3.01.definition: an original 8-K whose `items` lists 3.01 -- notice of delisting or failure to satisfy a listing rule. One event per ticker per filing date.
8k_item_3.01.why_forfeit_is_cheap: specification #4 (listing deficiency) was abandoned before declaration on 2026-11-11 -- docs/V27_SPEC4_LISTING_DEFICIENCY.md

8k_item_5.02.definition: an original 8-K whose `items` lists 5.02 -- departure or appointment of directors or officers, or compensation arrangements. One event per ticker per filing date.

8k_item_7.01.definition: an original 8-K whose `items` lists 7.01 -- Regulation FD disclosure. One event per ticker per filing date.

8k_item_8.01.definition: an original 8-K whose `items` lists 8.01 -- other events. One event per ticker per filing date.

form4_sale.definition: a Form 4 filing whose non-derivative transaction codes include S (open-market sale) and not P -- OBSERVER's direction_of() == 'sale'. One event per ticker per filing date, however many insiders filed. Source: Finnhub insider-transactions, the 1095-day pull of run 33927199851.
